source: Real PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE captured from isolated synthetic database
postgres_version: PostgreSQL 16.16 (Debian 16.16-1.pgdg12+1) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit
sql:
SELECT c.region, p.region AS parent_region, count(*) AS n, sum(o.amount) AS amount
FROM customers c JOIN customers p ON p.id=c.parent_id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id
WHERE c.region IN ('north','east') AND o.amount>200
GROUP BY c.region,p.region ORDER BY c.region,p.region;
